items.headline: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh Signals Potential Rate Increase at Jackson Hole Speech
items.summary: Speaking at the annual Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium on August 28, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh warned that persistent inflation could compel the central bank to raise interest rates further. His hawkish tone led financial markets to immediately raise the probability of an interest rate hike at the upcoming September meeting.

items.headline: Anthropic Unveils System Allowing AI to Autonomously Control Lab Equipment
items.summary: Anthropic has released a research preview of its Model Hardware Standard, which enables AI systems like Claude to programmatically control physical tools such as robotic arms, lasers, and microscopes. The initiative marks the company's first step into physical-world operations, allowing automated systems to run continuous scientific experiments.

items.headline: Andreas Leknessund Wins Emotional Vuelta Stage in Norwegian 1-2 Finish
items.summary: Norwegian cyclist Andreas Leknessund won stage seven of the Vuelta a España on Friday, leading a memorable one-two finish for team Uno-X Mobility alongside teammate Tobias Halland Johannessen. The team rode in black armbands following the death of King Harald V of Norway earlier in the day, while overall race leader Tadej Pogačar extended his lead.

items.headline: Apple TV Increases Monthly Subscription Fee to $14.99
items.summary: Apple announced on August 28 that the monthly price for its Apple TV streaming service is rising from $12.99 to $14.99, alongside a price increase for the Apple One individual bundle. This marks the platform's fourth price hike in four years as major streaming companies continue to raise subscription costs across the industry.
